name: mathpreview-frontend-lint
description: ESLint setup for the embedded viewer JavaScript bundles. The browser bundle lives as five files under crates/core/src/assets/client/ (header → viewer → proof → patch → footer) that share scope via one outer IIFE; lint concatenates them in renderer/shell.rs concat! order and feeds the result to ESLint via --stdin so cross-file references resolve.

scripts.lint:client: cat crates/core/src/assets/client/header.js crates/core/src/assets/client/viewer.js crates/core/src/assets/client/proof.js crates/core/src/assets/client/patch.js crates/core/src/assets/client/footer.js | eslint --stdin --stdin-filename=crates/core/src/assets/client.js
scripts.lint: npm run lint:client && npm run lint:engine
